# PartVision
> UK photo-to-CAD, reverse engineering and custom part manufacturing.

## What PartVision does
Customers upload photographs, sketches or CAD files. PartVision reviews feasibility, requests critical measurements, creates a CAD model for approval, confirms the manufacturing price, and produces the approved part.

## Services
- Photo to CAD reconstruction
- Replacement and obsolete parts
- Editable STEP model delivery where included in the quote
- FDM and resin 3D printing
- Specialist and metal manufacturing through disclosed review routes
- One-off and low-volume production

## Safety and accuracy
A single photograph is not always enough. Functional parts usually require multiple views and at least one known measurement. Complex geometry may require the physical sample or 3D scanning. Safety-critical, unlawful, weapon-related, counterfeit or infringing work may be refused.
